@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter zip-entry empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end
local function run(document)
local Z = P.zip; local e=Z.Entry('a.txt','abc',1700000001)
  probe('Z.Entry()', function() return Z.Entry() end)
  probe('Z.Entry(\039a\039)', function() return Z.Entry('a') end)
  probe('Z.Entry(\039a\039,{})', function() return Z.Entry('a',{}) end)
  probe('Z.Entry({},\039b\039)', function() return Z.Entry({},'b') end)
  probe('Z.Entry(\039a\039,\039b\039,1.5)', function() return Z.Entry('a','b',1.5) end)
  probe('Z.Entry(\039a\039,\039b\039,\039x\039)', function() return Z.Entry('a','b','x') end)
  probe('Z.Entry(12,34,0)', function() return Z.Entry(12,34,0) end)
  probe('entry fields', function() return P.utils.type(e), tostring(e), getmetatable(e), keys(e),e.path,e.modtime,e.unknown end)
  probe('entry operations', function() return e:contents(), e:contents('pw'), e:symlink() end)
  probe('password type', function() return e:contents({}) end)
  probe('change entry', function() e.path='b'; e.modtime=9; return e.path,e.modtime end)
  probe('restore entry', function() e.path=nil; e.modtime=nil; return e.path,e.modtime end)
  probe('unknown entry field', function() e.contents='x' end)
  probe('default timestamp', function() return math.abs(Z.Entry('a','').modtime-os.time()) <= 2 end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  local parts = {}

  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.

local function run(document)
local Z=P.zip; local e=Z.Entry('a','abc',1700000001); local a=Z.Archive{e}
  probe('Z.Archive(false)', function() return Z.Archive(false) end)
  probe('Z.Archive({1})', function() return Z.Archive({1}) end)
  probe('Z.Archive(123)', function() return Z.Archive(123) end)
  probe('Z.Archive(\039bad\039)', function() return Z.Archive('bad') end)
  probe('Z.Archive(\039not a zip\039)', function() return Z.Archive('not a zip') end)
  probe('archive fields', function() return P.utils.type(a), tostring(a), getmetatable(a), keys(a), P.utils.type(a.entries),a.unknown end)
  probe('empty archive', function() return #Z.Archive():bytestring(), #Z.Archive(nil).entries end)
  probe('zip round trip', function() local entry=Z.Archive(a:bytestring()).entries[1]; return entry.path,entry.modtime,entry:contents() end)
  probe('zip time floor', function() local entry=Z.Archive(Z.Archive{Z.Entry('a','a',0)}:bytestring()).entries[1]; return entry.modtime end)
  probe('stored or compressed', function() local bytes=string.rep('a',10000); local archive=Z.Archive{Z.Entry('large',bytes,1700000000)}; local zip=archive:bytestring(); return #zip<10000,Z.Archive(zip).entries[1]:contents()==bytes end)
  probe('archive snapshot', function() e.path='x'; return a.entries[1].path,rawequal(a.entries,a.entries) end)
  probe('insert', function() a.entries:insert(Z.Entry('b','b',0)); return #a.entries,Z.Archive(a:bytestring()).entries[2].path end)
  probe('assign entries', function() a.entries={e}; return a.entries[1].path,P.utils.type(a.entries) end)
  probe('restore entries', function() a.entries=nil; return #a.entries,P.utils.type(a.entries),a.entries[1].path end)
  probe('unknown archive field', function() a.contents='x' end)
  probe('extract options', function() return a:extract(false) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

local function run(document)
local Z=P.zip
  probe('Z.read_entry()', function() return Z.read_entry() end)
  probe('Z.read_entry({})', function() return Z.read_entry({}) end)
  probe('Z.zip()', function() return Z.zip() end)
  probe('Z.zip(\039x\039)', function() return Z.zip('x') end)
  probe('Z.zip({false})', function() return Z.zip({false}) end)
  probe('Z.zip({},false)', function() return Z.zip({},false) end)
  probe('Z.zip({})', function() return Z.zip({}) end)
  probe('read entry', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          local path=dir..'/f';write(path,'zip')
          local e=Z.read_entry(path)
          return e.path:sub(1,2),e.path:sub(-2),e:contents()
        end) end)
  probe('read location', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          local path=dir..'/f';write(path,'zip')
          return Z.read_entry(path,{location='pre'}).path:sub(1,2)

        end) end)
  probe('zip recursive', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          write(dir..'/f','fixture')
          local a=Z.zip({dir},{recursive=true})
          local entries=a.entries:filter(function(e) return not e.path:match('/%._[^/]+$') end)
          return #entries,entries[1].path:sub(-1),entries[2].path:sub(-2),entries[2]:contents()
        end) end)
  probe('zip directory only', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          write(dir..'/f','fixture')
          local a=Z.zip{dir}
          return #a.entries,a.entries[1].path:sub(-1)
        end) end)
  probe('symbolic links', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          write(dir..'/file','target')
          local link=dir..'/link'
          assert(os.execute('ln -s file '..string.format('%q',link)))
          local a=Z.zip({link},{preserve_symlinks=false}).entries[1]
          local b=Z.zip({link},{preserve_symlinks=true}).entries[1]
          return a:contents(),a:symlink(),b:contents(),b:symlink()
        end) end)
  probe('extract', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          local a=Z.Archive{Z.Entry('sub/','',0), Z.Entry('sub/file','abc',0)}
          a:extract({destination=dir})
          local f=assert(io.open(dir..'/sub/file','rb')); local content=f:read('*a'); f:close()
          return content
        end) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
